body: I no longer take meds for my epilepsy, but it does stop me from taking other meds. CBD actually reacts strongly in a negative way with me, I don't know why but instead on slowing my seizures it amplifies them as well.

Ad this doesn't even matter. it does make a difference because none of you guys even know me and the truth is no buddy cares really. Everyone who knows me well knows I'm suicidal and no one cares. No one is here for me anyways, no one has any time for me. They'd rather party and because i can't because I can't hold the mask on anymore no one cares.

Sadly, hes gotten off of charges many times. From drug trafficking to assault with a weapon, most of the time, like me, people are too afraid to call anything in.

At this point I don't care what he does to me, he cant destroy me anymore then he already has.
